number_review.method: Named-identity mapping to exact own-card fields, not global number matching. style_depth: Accepted: IBM/SAP/NOW monetization versus spending, credit collateral versus broad ETF returns, NextEra demand outlook versus current miss, China profit improvement versus household/property weakness, and local Polish consumer/fiscal/governance comparisons provide substantive causal depth. Conditional additions/reductions align with Mixed macro, Bearish autos/Tesla/Mercedes and selective Bullish3M/Newmont.
limits: Headline scope only; no article-body verification, network, retail review or publication. Price observations are distinct from allocation flows, spreads, and operating outcomes.
